text: Been on hold for ages and nobody's rung back so I'm trying this. My daughter's 4, temp was 38.5 about twenty mins ago. She's really hard to wake up, I think? She's also got these little dark red dots on her tummy and I pressed a glass on them like you're meant to and I'm fairly sure they didn't go away.
